# Excersice for the Open Science course

The goal of OpenScience-demo is to test what we learned during the course week on Open Sciense in Finse in 2026.

This repo store vegetation data collected in 2025 in Franzigmark, Germany. The species richness data and the management effect on it is plotted.

The data are under CC BY 4.0 license and the code under MIT license.
To reproduce the code and the quarto manuscript, please run in your console:
```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(targets)
tar_make()
```
